messages.subject: Phase A recon complete: Privacy Act 1988 ingest is cheap and Part IIIC is present
messages.body: Located the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) as one DOCX volume on legislation.gov.au (compilation 104, no redirects, host accepted by the allowlist), and confirmed all 28 Part IIIC sections (26WA-26XH) carry real operative subsections with (1)/(2) markers, not just contents entries, by running Michael's own split_sections and SECTION_RE against the extracted text. Capacity is a non-issue (338GB local free, ~5-10MB projected DB growth) and the spend gate is trivially cleared at an estimated $0.003-$0.011 to embed the whole Act; I also found and am flagging, not fixing, a real bug where _is_contents_entry misreads the heading '26WD ... My Health Records Act 2012' as a contents row and would silently drop that one Part IIIC section on ingest. Nothing ingested, no DB write, no embedding call made; full evidence (URLs, excerpts, arithmetic) is in the attached report. Waiting on your/the owner's call on the 26WD parser bug and on approval to proceed to Phase B.
